nodes.label: Themes Icon
nodes.description: A color palette and paintbrush SVG icon used for the Themes/Customize entry in the GooseOS Win95-style desktop. The palette body is a large teardrop shape in golden yellow (#FEC656) with five multicolored paint swirls arranged around its surface in red (#F16D6E), green (#80C350), slate-blue (#637888), brown (#B06D48), and teal (#60C3AB). A paintbrush handle is rendered on the left side with a grey gradient barrel and a red bristle tip, consistent with classic Win95-era 'Display Properties / Themes' iconography. Sourced from SVG Repo (SVG Repo Mixer Tools). 800x800 viewBox scaled to 502.441x502.441 internal units.
